name: No Empty Threats
source:
You had a life beyond this. Once. You think. It'll get worse from here. Worse. And worse. Better make sure you know who you're pointing that gun at.


[From [url=https://snekofspice.itch.io/no-empty-threats]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的生活超越了这个。一次。你认为。从这里开始情况会变得更糟。更糟糕的是。更糟糕的是。最好确保你知道你用枪指着谁。


[来自[url=https://snekofspice.itch.io/no-empty-threats]itch.io[/url]]
